rubric.notes: Each of three distinct, valid transport processes earns 1 mark for naming plus correctly describing it; equivalent wording accepted. Naming without an adequate description earns half. Repeats of the same process (e.g. endocytosis and phagocytosis counted separately only if clearly distinct) earn no additional marks.
